conditions.description: The policy allows Action * on Resource *.
conditions.rationale: This grants the principal the broadest identity-policy capability instead of a bounded application permission set.
Unrestricted role passing can expand privilege through services that accept IAM roles.
The identity policy does not constrain decryption permission to intended keys.

conditions.description: sts:AssumeRole is allowed for every role ARN in every AWS account.
conditions.rationale: The identity-side permission is not scoped to intended target roles or accounts.

conditions.description: logs:GetLogEvents is scoped to one explicit application log-group ARN pattern.
conditions.rationale: This statement must not be falsely described as Resource *.

conditions.description: The policy contains an explicit Deny for insecure S3 transport to the named bucket.
conditions.rationale: The SecureTransport deny control is present and should not be reported missing.

conditions.description: Applicable service-control policies are not established by this identity policy.
conditions.rationale: SCPs are organization-side external controls that can further constrain effective permissions.

conditions.description: The trust policies of roles matched by sts:AssumeRole are not established here.
conditions.rationale: Actual role assumption also depends on target-role trust policies that are absent from the fixture.

conditions.description: The identity policy must not be cleared as least-privileged.
conditions.rationale: Administrative wildcard access and multiple unrestricted privilege-amplifying permissions are explicitly present.

conditions.description: The policy must not be cleared as having a narrowly bounded credential blast radius.
conditions.rationale: Wildcard administration, decryption, role passing, and broad role assumption make the identity-side blast radius large even though external controls may exist.
